text_outlining.method: Only the live ASM text is converted to vector glyph paths through CairoSVG PDF text and PyMuPDF SVG path export. Original polygons and clipping geometry are retained.
text_outlining.font_source: NimbusSans-Regular.otf from the pinned graph-plotting bundle
text_outlining.font_license_note: The font is under GNU AGPL version 3 with the font document-embedding exception. No font binary is redistributed.

png.method: Rasterise the final vector-composited PDF at the poster placement size.

horizontal_alignment.method: One horizontal translation of all axes, figure text and legend from their combined tight bounds.

acceptance_ids.independent_physics: Retained accepted source checks and final producer gates.
acceptance_ids.limits: Producer limits remain unchanged. CPU quiet gates are empirical, and reused canonical floating-point flag scope retains its recorded unknowns.

scope: Accepted supplied summaries are drawn unchanged. Metadata checks do not repeat scientific verification.
